clue.text: Devious boy (no model) gets investment to make a killing

indicators.note: devious means winding or crooked, so the letters take a twisted new order

explanation.surface: A shifty lad who has dropped a fashion model gets backing for a big financial win.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Devious' scrambles BOY plus NO MODEL; 'make a killing' pretends to be about profit but is literal here.
explanation.definitionFit: Blood money is cash paid to a hired murderer, an outlay to get someone killed.

clue.text: Black and blue from knock

parts.note: B is the standard abbreviation for black, as on pencils
blue means sad or low in spirits

explanation.surface: Bruises left by being struck.
explanation.definitionFit: A knock and a blow are both synonyms for a hard hit.

clue.text: Thesis supporting working — in theory

indicators.note: in a down clue the supporting piece sits beneath the other one

parts.note: a machine that is working is switched on
a thesis is an academic paper

explanation.surface: A dissertation backing up practical work is only theoretical.
explanation.definitionFit: Something true on paper holds in theory but may not in practice; an idiom.

clue.text: Fair start to day — is most of Bury relaxed?

indicators.note: the start of a word is its opening letter
most of a word means all but its final letter

parts.note: to bury a body is to inter it
having relaxed is having rested

explanation.surface: A question about whether the Lancashire town of Bury is laid-back at daybreak.
explanation.walkthrough: Bury is a town in Lancashire, England; here it is the verb meaning inter, trimmed to INTE.
explanation.definitionFit: Disinterested means impartial, having no stake, which is what a fair judge is.

clue.text: Veteran's second-hand watch?

definitions.meaning: an old hand, someone long in the job
a timepiece bought used, read as an aged clock

explanation.surface: An old soldier's watch was bought used.
explanation.definitionFit: An old-timer is a long-serving veteran; read literally it is an old timepiece.

clue.text: Looking at, for example, incorporating Chinese principle

indicators.note: incorporating means taking something into the body of another piece

parts.note: EG is the abbreviation of exempli gratia, for example
yin is the passive principle of Chinese philosophy

explanation.surface: Studying something such as a Chinese philosophical idea.
explanation.definitionFit: Eying is watching or gazing at something, a direct synonym.

clue.text: Cheerful after company's success

indicators.note: after means this piece is placed behind the one that follows it in the clue

parts.note: CO is the abbreviation for company
being cheerful is being up

explanation.surface: A firm's triumph comes after a cheerful mood.
explanation.definitionFit: A coup is a brilliant stroke or notable victory.

clue.text: Herb's terrible anger, wearing glasses

indicators.note: wearing means being clothed by something, here placed inside it

parts.note: a pair of glasses looks like two letter Os side by side

indicators.note: terrible signals the letters are turned into a mess

explanation.surface: A herb is in a terrible rage while wearing spectacles.
explanation.walkthrough: 'terrible' signals the anagram and 'wearing' the container; 'Herb's' reads as a man's name but is the plant, with 's as a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Oregano is a culinary herb used in Mediterranean cooking.

clue.text: Are its pies cooked in France?

definitions.text: Are its pies cooked in France?

indicators.note: cooked suggests the letters are worked over and reformed

explanation.surface: A question about whether French pies are baked.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cooked' rearranges ARE ITS PIES; the whole clue also describes a French pastry shop.
explanation.definitionFit: A patisserie is a French cake and pastry shop where such pies are baked.

clue.text: Sat on work being challenged

indicators.note: on means placed after the other piece in an across answer

parts.note: OP is short for opus, a work
a model who sat for an artist posed

explanation.surface: Someone sat on a project while it was disputed.
explanation.definitionFit: Being opposed is being contested or challenged by others.

clue.text: Examine honour (in replacing soldiers)

indicators.note: replacing means one piece is swapped in where another stood

parts.note: to honour someone is to respect them
RE is the Royal Engineers, British army soldiers
taken as written

explanation.surface: Look over the honour given when soldiers are swapped out.
explanation.definitionFit: To inspect is to examine closely; direct synonym.

clue.text: In-form professional?

parts.note: read as in-form, someone who works on a school form or class, rather than a player on top form

explanation.definitionFit: A school teacher is a professional who works within a form, a British word for a class.

clue.text: In case of problems, popular monarchs try these for cutting material

indicators.note: In means the following run goes inside the outer pair
the case of a word is its outer shell, its first and last letters

parts.note: something popular is in
kings are monarchs
to try a case in court is to hear it

explanation.surface: In tricky cases, well-liked kings might try out these tailoring tools.
explanation.definitionFit: Pinking shears are serrated scissors used to cut fabric so it does not fray.

clue.text: Focuses on insults about belly

indicators.note: about means going round the other piece

parts.note: slights are insults
a pot belly, so pot means belly

explanation.surface: Someone concentrates on jibes about a paunch.
explanation.definitionFit: To spotlight something is to highlight it or focus attention on it.

clue.text: Supplied half clean, changing every day

indicators.note: half means the first two of four letters

parts.note: clean means pure

indicators.note: changing tells us the letters alter their order

explanation.surface: Provided half-clean goods, swapping them daily.
explanation.definitionFit: Purveyed means provided or sold goods, as a purveyor does.

clue.text: Doctor got up in a dark mood

parts.note: MO is a Medical Officer, a doctor
to have got up is to have risen, so rose

explanation.surface: A doctor rose from bed feeling gloomy.
explanation.definitionFit: Morose means sullen and gloomy, an adjective matching the phrase.

clue.text: Approves, provided one is included in charges

indicators.note: is included in means placed inside the other piece

parts.note: rates are charges or fees
provided means if, as in on condition that
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: Someone approves on condition that a single item is part of the fees.
explanation.definitionFit: To ratify is to approve formally, as with a treaty.

clue.text: Proposed putting daughter on board

indicators.note: on means placed after the board piece in an across answer

parts.note: a table is a board, as in bed and board

explanation.surface: Suggested seating a daughter at the table.
explanation.definitionFit: To table a motion is, in British usage, to put it forward for discussion.

clue.text: Type of story found in part of garden magazine?

parts.note: a flower bed is part of a garden
Time is a news magazine

explanation.surface: A question about what genre of tale appears in a gardening section of a periodical.
explanation.definitionFit: A bedtime story is a kind of tale told to children before sleep.

clue.text: A spit designed to hold sheep or beef

indicators.note: to hold means to grip something inside
designed suggests the letters are freshly arranged

parts.note: a ram is a male sheep

explanation.surface: A roasting spit made to hold mutton or beef.
explanation.walkthrough: 'designed' rearranges A SPIT into PAST I, which holds RAM.
explanation.definitionFit: Pastrami is a highly seasoned smoked beef.

clue.text: Maintained the Bible was wrong

parts.note: AV is the Authorised Version of the Bible
to have erred is to have been wrong

explanation.surface: Someone insisted scripture was mistaken.
explanation.definitionFit: Averred means asserted or maintained as true.

clue.text: Piano duet regularly finish uncertain

indicators.note: regularly means taking every other letter

parts.note: to finish is to terminate

explanation.surface: A piano duet keeps ending in an unsure way.
explanation.definitionFit: Indeterminate means not fixed or definite, so uncertain.

clue.text: Perhaps Jamaican artist comes across a way

indicators.note: comes across means spanning round the other piece

parts.note: RA is a Royal Academician, an artist
taken as written
ST is the abbreviation for street, a way

explanation.surface: A Caribbean painter crosses a road.
explanation.definitionFit: A Rasta, a Rastafarian, is often Jamaican; perhaps signals definition by example.

clue.text: Last year's problem affecting viewer

indicators.note: 's here means has: the words before it hold the hidden answer

parts.note: the letters sit inside these words

explanation.surface: A bother from the previous year that affects someone watching.
explanation.definitionFit: A stye is an eyelid infection, a problem for the eye that views.

clue.text: Cuts affairs after hotel broadcast

indicators.note: after means placed behind the other pieces

parts.note: H is hotel in the NATO phonetic alphabet
to broadcast is to air
dos are parties or affairs

explanation.surface: Budget cuts to events after a hotel is broadcast.
explanation.definitionFit: Hairdos are haircuts or styled cuts of hair.

clue.text: Be left rebuilding their following at home

indicators.note: following means this piece comes after the other

parts.note: someone at home is in

indicators.note: rebuilding suggests the letters are put together anew

explanation.surface: Being left to rebuild a house after staying in.
explanation.definitionFit: To inherit is to be left something in a will.

clue.text: Try to find and understand source of knowledge

parts.note: to see is to understand

indicators.note: the source of a word is its opening letter

explanation.surface: Searching and grasping the origin of wisdom.
explanation.definitionFit: To seek is to look for or search for.

clue.text: Rocker attached to musical game played with string

indicators.note: attached to means this piece is joined on after the other one

parts.note: Cats is a stage musical
a cradle rocks a baby, so it is a rocker

explanation.surface: A rock fan joins a stage show game with string.
explanation.definitionFit: Cat's cradle is a children's game of making string figures on the fingers.
